selection: ALL four previously benchmarked v0.18 cases, not newly held out; no outcome filtering. Shared prefix of 3 attempts from depth; exclude early public solutions and infrastructure failures from actual fork. Freeze rule before new inference.
token_limit: Soft reported token stop before a subsequent call; no hard per-call token ceiling. Any overshoot/incomplete tokens will be reported.
fork_condition: Exactly three identical evaluated public failures must produce depth revise attempt-3 and adaptive new-root. Enforce actual divergence or abort.
model_context: Both continuations inherit same generated/evaluated common prefix, task and public outcomes. Intervention differs by selected source parent (baseline revises vs Nykra independent root). Inference randomness after fork remains.
scoring: Full success = selected public-passing continuation repair also passes separate hidden cases once. Previously solved prefixes are counted as shared ceilings, not win/loss.
limits: Same already-seen historical BugsInPy tasks, tiny sample, model stochasticity, restricted one-function patches, Docker not certified hostile-code isolation; no general improvement inference.
